# renanleonel/ui

> A shadcn registry on Base UI: accessible, themeable components, hooks and full-screen blocks for React and Next.js. Install an item with `npx shadcn add <url>`, or `npx shadcn add @renanleonel/<name>` after registering the namespace (see README).

## Base

### base

[renanleonel/ui](https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/base.json): Everything: tokens, default theme, utils and all components.

Install: `npx shadcn add https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/base.json`

## Styles

### tokens

[Design tokens](https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/tokens.json): Layer-2 tokens (control size, control radius, shadows) on top of the shadcn theme contract.

Install: `npx shadcn add https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/tokens.json`

Changelog:
- 2026-11-14: New duration tokens: --ds-duration-fill (300ms) and --ds-duration-reveal (500ms)

## Components

### accordion

[Accordion](https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/accordion.json): Stacked sections that expand one or several at a time.

Install: `npx shadcn add https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/accordion.json`

npm: @base-ui/react@^1.9.0, cn@^0.5.2, lucide-react@^1.72.0
Exports: Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger

Notes:
- The panel height animates; reduced motion keeps only a fade.

Changelog:
- 2026-11-13: tree select, sortable dragFrom, themes page, docs footer and site polish

### alert

[Alert](https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/alert.json): An inline message, as a bordered card or a tinted callout.

Install: `npx shadcn add https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/alert.json`

npm: class-variance-authority@^0.7.1, cn@^0.5.2
Exports: Alert, AlertAction, AlertDescription, AlertTitle

Notes:
- `tone` makes a borderless tinted callout; an `AlertAction` sits on the trailing edge.

Changelog:
- 2026-11-13: tree select, sortable dragFrom, themes page, docs footer and site polish
- 2026-11-13: axe-core accessibility audit on every page, 4 parallel audit shards; fix every violation

### alert-dialog

[Alert Dialog](https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/alert-dialog.json): Asks for confirmation before a destructive action.

Install: `npx shadcn add https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/alert-dialog.json`

npm: @base-ui/react@^1.9.0, cn@^0.5.2
Needs: button
Exports: AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogMedia, AlertDialogOverlay, AlertDialogPortal, AlertDialogTitle, AlertDialogTrigger

Notes:
- Prefer undo over confirmation for reversible actions (see Toast).
- Clicking outside doesn't dismiss it.

Changelog:
- 2026-11-13: tree select, sortable dragFrom, themes page, docs footer and site polish

### avatar

[Avatar](https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/avatar.json): A user's picture with initials as fallback, alone or stacked.

Install: `npx shadcn add https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/avatar.json`

npm: @base-ui/react@^1.9.0, cn@^0.5.2
Exports: Avatar, AvatarBadge, AvatarFallback, AvatarGroup, AvatarGroupCount, AvatarImage

### avatar-group

[Avatar group](https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/avatar-group.json): Overlapping avatars built from a list of people, with a +N chip that lists the rest.

Install: `npx shadcn add https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/avatar-group.json`

Needs: avatar, popover, utils
Exports: AvatarStack

Notes:
- Exports `AvatarStack`; `avatar.tsx` keeps `AvatarGroup` for composing avatars by hand.
- `max` sets how many show; the +N chip opens a popover (touch and keyboard friendly) with everyone else, capped at 100 rows.
- Each avatar is named for screen readers and carries the name as a hover title.

Changelog:
- 2026-11-14: New: AvatarStack with +N popover

### badge

[Badge](https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/badge.json): Status pills and counts in seven contrast-checked tones.

Install: `npx shadcn add https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/badge.json`

npm: @base-ui/react@^1.9.0, class-variance-authority@^0.7.1, cn@^0.5.2
Needs: utils
Exports: Badge, badgeVariants

Notes:
- `tone` replaces the variant's colors with a tint of the tone.

Changelog:
- 2026-11-13: axe-core accessibility audit on every page, 4 parallel audit shards; fix every violation

### breadcrumb

[Breadcrumb](https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/breadcrumb.json): Where this page sits in the hierarchy, with links back up.

Install: `npx shadcn add https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/breadcrumb.json`

npm: @base-ui/react@^1.9.0, cn@^0.5.2, lucide-react@^1.72.0
Exports: Breadcrumb, BreadcrumbEllipsis, BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbLink, BreadcrumbList, BreadcrumbPage, BreadcrumbSeparator

Notes:
- The current page is `aria-current="page"` and not a link.

### button

[Button](https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/button.json): Actions with press feedback, a smooth loading state and an optional hotkey.

Install: `npx shadcn add https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/button.json`

npm: @base-ui/react@^1.9.0, @tanstack/react-hotkeys@0.25.0, class-variance-authority@^0.7.1, cn@^0.5.2
Needs: hotkey, spinner, use-hotkey-press, utils
Exports: Button, buttonVariants

Notes:
- `loading` keeps the label, slides a spinner in and blocks clicks while keeping focus.
- `hotkey="Mod+S"` presses the button from anywhere; `showHotkey` renders the key caps.
- Icon-only buttons need an `aria-label`; the hit area grows to 44px on touch screens.

Changelog:
- 2026-11-13: stress-test pass with break-ui, mobile-native, gestures, motion and sonner skills
- 2026-11-13: axe-core accessibility audit on every page, 4 parallel audit shards; fix every violation

### calendar

[Calendar](https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/calendar.json): A month grid for picking a day or a range (react-day-picker).

Install: `npx shadcn add https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/calendar.json`

npm: cn@^0.5.2, date-fns@^4.4.0, lucide-react@^1.72.0, react-day-picker@^10.0.2
Needs: button, select
Exports: Calendar, CalendarDayButton

Notes:
- Arrow keys move by day, Page Up/Down by month.
- Cells grow to 40px on touch screens, shrinking to fit a 320px sheet.
- Month and year pickers (`captionLayout="dropdown"`) are our Select, not the browser's.

Changelog:
- 2026-11-13: month/year pickers use Select; nav lets caption clicks through; touch cells fit 320px
- 2026-11-13: square icon buttons in input groups and calendar nav
- 2026-11-13: axe-core accessibility audit on every page, 4 parallel audit shards; fix every violation

### card

[Card](https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/card.json): A surface with a header, content and footer.

Install: `npx shadcn add https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/card.json`

npm: cn@^0.5.2
Exports: Card, CardAction, CardContent, CardDescription, CardFooter, CardHeader, CardTitle

Notes:
- `size="sm"` tightens the spacing.

Changelog:
- 2026-11-13: tree select, sortable dragFrom, themes page, docs footer and site polish

### carousel

[Carousel](https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/carousel.json): A swipeable set of slides with arrows, dots, keyboard control, vertical and RTL support (embla).

Install: `npx shadcn add https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/carousel.json`

npm: @base-ui/react@^1.9.0, cn@^0.5.2, embla-carousel-react@^8.6.0, lucide-react@^1.72.0
Needs: button, use-media-query
Exports: Carousel, CarouselApi, CarouselContent, CarouselDots, CarouselItem, CarouselNext, CarouselPrevious, useCarousel

Notes:
- Compose `CarouselContent` > `CarouselItem`, then `CarouselPrevious`, `CarouselNext` and `CarouselDots`; pass options through `opts`.
- Arrow keys move while focus is inside (Up/Down when vertical, mirrored in RTL); reduced motion turns every move into a jump.
- Slides are named "2 of 5" with `aria-roledescription="slide"`; override with `aria-label` on the item.

Changelog:
- 2026-11-14: New: carousel on Embla with dots, keyboard and RTL

### chart

[Chart](https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/chart.json): Recharts with a validated categorical palette, DS tooltips and legends.

Install: `npx shadcn add https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/chart.json`

npm: cn@^0.5.2, recharts@3.8.0
Exports: ChartConfig, ChartContainer, ChartLegend, ChartLegendContent, ChartStyle, ChartTooltip, ChartTooltipContent

Notes:
- Series colors are `--ds-chart-1` to `-8` (`fill-series-1`…): the same hues in every theme, validated for color blindness in light and dark. Assign them in order, never cycled.
- Two or more series always get a legend; every chart gets a tooltip.
- One y-axis per chart: two measures of different scale go in two charts.

Changelog:
- 2026-11-14: lighthouse and react doctor pass across docs site and registry
- 2026-11-13: tree select, sortable dragFrom, themes page, docs footer and site polish
- 2026-11-13: chart tooltip valueFormatter + round axis ticks on the dashboard; demo control labeled and hideable; back link on auth and setup demos
- 2026-11-13: no browser outline on Recharts 3 inner layers after a click; DS focus ring on keyboard focus

### checkbox

[Checkbox](https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/checkbox.json): On, off or mixed. The whole label toggles it.

Install: `npx shadcn add https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/checkbox.json`

npm: @base-ui/react@^1.9.0, cn@^0.5.2, lucide-react@^1.72.0
Exports: Checkbox

Notes:
- `indeterminate` shows a dash, for a parent of partly selected rows.
- The hit area extends past the box, so small checkboxes stay easy to tap.

### collapsible

[Collapsible](https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/collapsible.json): A single section that shows or hides its content from a trigger.

Install: `npx shadcn add https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/collapsible.json`

npm: @base-ui/react@^1.9.0, cn@^0.5.2
Exports: Collapsible, CollapsibleContent, CollapsibleTrigger

Notes:
- Unstyled trigger: pass a Button through render. Use an accordion for several related sections.
- The panel height animates like the accordion; reduced motion keeps only a fade.

Changelog:
- 2026-11-14: New: collapsible with the accordion height transition

### color-picker

[Color Picker](https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/color-picker.json): A color field that opens a saturation and hue area, an optional opacity slider, a hex input and preset swatches.

Install: `npx shadcn add https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/color-picker.json`

npm: cn@^0.5.2, lucide-react@^1.72.0, react-colorful@^5.8.1
Needs: input-group, popover, swatch-picker, use-controllable-state
Exports: ColorPicker, ColorPreset

Notes:
- The value is lowercase hex: `#rrggbb`, or `#rrggbbaa` with `alpha`.
- Invalid hex typed into the input never reaches `onValueChange`; it shows an error and reverts on blur.
- Presets reuse `SwatchPicker`; the area and sliders are react-colorful's and keyboard operable.

Changelog:
- 2026-11-14: New: color picker on react-colorful with hex input and presets

### combobox

[Combobox](https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/combobox.json): Type to filter a list and pick one value.

Install: `npx shadcn add https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/combobox.json`

npm: @base-ui/react@^1.9.0, @tanstack/react-virtual@^3.14.26, cn@^0.5.2, lucide-react@^1.72.0
Needs: button, input-group
Exports: Combobox, ComboboxChip, ComboboxChips, ComboboxChipsInput, ComboboxCollection, ComboboxContent, ComboboxEmpty, ComboboxGroup, ComboboxInput, ComboboxItem, ComboboxLabel, ComboboxList, ComboboxSeparator, ComboboxTrigger, ComboboxValue, ComboboxVirtualList, useComboboxAnchor

Notes:
- Use it once a list has 8 or more options.
- Arrow keys move, Enter picks, Escape closes.
- Past a few hundred options, set `virtualized` on `Combobox` and render rows with `ComboboxVirtualList`.

Changelog:
- 2026-11-14: lighthouse and react doctor pass across docs site and registry
- 2026-11-13: tree select, sortable dragFrom, themes page, docs footer and site polish
- 2026-11-13: virtualize long lists and tables, debounce inputs, add 8 components

### context-menu

[Context Menu](https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/context-menu.json): A menu at the pointer on right click or long press, styled like the dropdown menu.

Install: `npx shadcn add https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/context-menu.json`

npm: @base-ui/react@^1.9.0, cn@^0.5.2
Needs: dropdown-menu
Exports: ContextMenu, ContextMenuCheckboxItem, ContextMenuContent, ContextMenuGroup, ContextMenuItem, ContextMenuLabel, ContextMenuRadioGroup, ContextMenuRadioItem, ContextMenuSeparator, ContextMenuShortcut, ContextMenuSub, ContextMenuSubContent, ContextMenuSubTrigger, ContextMenuTrigger

Notes:
- Rows (items, checkboxes, radios, submenus, hotkeys) are the dropdown menu's, so both look identical.
- Keep every action reachable another way: touch and some browsers never open it.

Changelog:
- 2026-11-14: New: context menu sharing the dropdown menu rows

### copy-button

[Copy button](https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/copy-button.json): An icon button that copies a value and confirms with a check, a tooltip and a screen-reader announcement.

Install: `npx shadcn add https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/copy-button.json`

npm: cn@^0.5.2, lucide-react@^1.72.0
Needs: button, tooltip, use-copy-to-clipboard
Exports: CopyButton

Notes:
- Built on `useCopyToClipboard`, which resolves `false` instead of throwing when the Clipboard API is unavailable.
- `value` can be a function, read at click time.
- Name what is copied with `label` ("Copy API key").

Changelog:
- 2026-11-14: New: copy button with live announcement

### data-list

[Data List](https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/data-list.json): Label and value pairs that reflow with their container.

Install: `npx shadcn add https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/data-list.json`

npm: cn@^0.5.2
Exports: DataItem, DataList

Notes:
- `layout="row"` spreads short pairs across a line; `stack` lists them.

Changelog:
- 2026-11-13: stress-test pass with break-ui, mobile-native, gestures, motion and sonner skills

### date-picker

[Date Picker](https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/date-picker.json): A form field that opens a calendar, for a single date, a range, or a date and time.

Install: `npx shadcn add https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/date-picker.json`

npm: cn@^0.5.2, date-fns@^4.4.0, lucide-react@^1.72.0, react-day-picker@^10.0.2
Needs: button, calendar, popover, time-input, use-media-query
Exports: DatePicker, DateRangePicker, DateTimePicker

Notes:
- `DateTimePicker`: the calendar with a column of time slots (a row on phones); picking the time closes it.
- Looks and behaves like a Select; `clearable` adds a clear button for optional dates.
- A bottom sheet on phones; the range picker shows one month there and two elsewhere.
- Ranges: the first click starts, the second ends and closes.
- Forms: `name` submits ISO dates; `onBlur` fires when the calendar closes, so validation waits until then.
- `captionLayout="dropdown"` with `startMonth`/`endMonth` for far dates (birthdays).
- Labels use date-fns patterns (`dateFormat`).

Changelog:
- 2026-11-13: tree select, sortable dragFrom, themes page, docs footer and site polish
- 2026-11-13: form-ready date fields; calendar month/year use Select

### dialog

[Dialog](https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/dialog.json): A modal window. Becomes a bottom drawer on phones.

Install: `npx shadcn add https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/dialog.json`

npm: @base-ui/react@^1.9.0, cn@^0.5.2, lucide-react@^1.72.0
Needs: button, drawer, use-media-query
Exports: Dialog, DialogClose, DialogContent, DialogDescription, DialogFooter, DialogHeader, DialogOverlay, DialogPortal, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger

Notes:
- Below 640px it renders as a drawer you can swipe down; opt out with `responsive={false}`.
- Focus is trapped inside and returns to the trigger on close.

Changelog:
- 2026-11-13: tree select, sortable dragFrom, themes page, docs footer and site polish

### form

[Form](https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/form.json): react-hook-form and zod wired to fields: validation on blur, then live; a banner for server errors.

Install: `npx shadcn add https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/form.json`

npm: @hookform/resolvers@^7.0.6, cn@^0.5.2, lucide-react@^1.72.0, react-hook-form@^7.92.0, zod@^4.6.7
Needs: alert, button, field, settings-list
Exports: Form, FormBanner, FormField, FormSubmit, useZodForm

Notes:
- `useZodForm(schema)` validates on blur, then on every change.
- Errors thrown from `onSubmit` become a banner at the top of the form.
- Double submits are blocked while a submit is pending; the first invalid field takes focus.

Changelog:
- 2026-11-13: tree select, sortable dragFrom, themes page, docs footer and site polish
- 2026-11-13: settings list, swatch picker, timezone select, unsaved-changes bar

### inline-edit

[Inline edit](https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/inline-edit.json): Text that becomes an input on click: Enter or blur saves, Escape cancels, with validation and optimistic async saves.

Install: `npx shadcn add https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/inline-edit.json`

npm: cn@^0.5.2, lucide-react@^1.72.0, sonner@^2.0.8
Needs: input, spinner, use-controllable-state
Exports: InlineEdit

Notes:
- Saves optimistically; if `onSubmit` throws the text rolls back and a toast offers Retry (needs a `Toaster`).
- `validate` returns a message to keep the field open with the error under it.
- Controlled (`value`) or uncontrolled (`defaultValue`); the value changes after `onSubmit` resolves.

Changelog:

### input

[Input](https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/input.json): Single-line text field sized by the control tokens.

Install: `npx shadcn add https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/input.json`

npm: @base-ui/react@^1.9.0, cn@^0.5.2, lucide-react@^1.72.0
Needs: button, use-hotkey-press
Exports: Input

Notes:
- 16px text on touch screens so iOS never zooms on focus.
- `clearable` adds an X while there's a value; it fires `onChange` like typing, then `onClear`.
- `copyable` adds a copy button with a check to confirm; read-only copyable fields select their text on focus.
- `type="file"` shows the picked file's name instead of the browser's "Choose File" button, with an X to unselect.
- Pair with `Field` or `FormField` for label, description and error.

npm: @tanstack/react-hotkeys@0.25.0, cn@^0.5.2, lucide-react@^1.72.0, next-themes@^0.4.6
Needs: button, toggle-group
Exports: ThemeSwitcher, ThemeToggle

Notes:
- Built on next-themes (`ThemeProvider attribute="class"`).
- The toggle picks its icon with CSS, so there is no flash or hydration mismatch; with a `hotkey` it switches instantly.

### time-input

[Time Input](https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/time-input.json): A time of day, typed in the browser's segmented field or picked from a styled list; plus a start–end range as one field.

Install: `npx shadcn add https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/time-input.json`

npm: cn@^0.5.2, lucide-react@^1.72.0
Needs: input-group, popover, use-hotkey-press
Exports: TimeInput, TimeRangeInput, TimeSlots, type TimeRange

Notes:
- The clock opens slots every `interval` minutes (default 30) within `min`/`max`; picking fires `onChange` like typing.
- `step` is in seconds: 900 snaps the arrows to 15 minutes; under 60 adds seconds.
- `TimeRangeInput`: pick the start, then the end (it can't come first); shows the length and submits `09:00/17:30`.
- For a date and a time together, use `DateTimePicker` from Date Picker.

Changelog:
- 2026-11-14: lighthouse and react doctor pass across docs site and registry
- 2026-11-13: tree select, sortable dragFrom, themes page, docs footer and site polish
- 2026-11-13: virtualize long lists and tables, debounce inputs, add 8 components

### tooltip

[Tooltip](https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/tooltip.json): A short label for an icon or a hint, with an optional hotkey.

Install: `npx shadcn add https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/tooltip.json`

npm: @base-ui/react@^1.9.0, @tanstack/react-hotkeys@0.25.0, cn@^0.5.2
Needs: hotkey
Exports: Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipOverflow, TooltipProvider, TooltipTrigger

Notes:
- Opens after 400ms (`TooltipOverflow`: 200ms); moving between tooltips is instant.
- Never put essential information only in a tooltip: touch screens can't hover.
- `TooltipOverflow` truncates text (or clamps to `lines`) and shows the tooltip only while it's cut off, for fixed-width columns.

Changelog:
- 2026-11-13: tree select, sortable dragFrom, themes page, docs footer and site polish

### tree

[Tree](https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/tree.json): A virtualized file-explorer tree with keyboard navigation, selection and filtering.

Install: `npx shadcn add https://ds.renanleonel.com/r/tree.json`

npm: @tanstack/react-virtual@^3.14.26, cn@^0.5.2, lucide-react@^1.72.0
Exports: Tree, TreeNode, indexTree

Notes:
- Only rows in view render: tens of thousands of nodes stay fast.
- Arrows move and open, Home/End jump, Enter selects, * opens siblings, typing jumps to a label.
- `filter` shows matches with their ancestors; debounce it with `useDebouncedState`.
- The chevron opens and closes without selecting; the highlight covers only the icon and label.
- `multiple` turns rows into checkboxes; each node toggles on its own.

Changelog:

- 2026-11-13: tree select, sortable dragFrom, themes page, docs footer and site polish
